summary: Introduce a Tailwind CSS v4 semantic mapping layer and tailwind-variants implementation pattern while preserving En UI CSS variables, public APIs, visuals, behavior, and accessibility.

components: Prove Button, Field/Input, and Alert before any later catalog migration.
consumers: Consumers continue importing one compiled @enosta/en-ui stylesheet and do not install Tailwind.
contracts: Record component styling variables and generated variant metadata without changing consumer-facing React contracts.
documentation: Document the hybrid CSS-variable, Tailwind v4, and tailwind-variants authoring model for maintainers and AI agents.
foundations: Map existing semantic CSS variables into Tailwind CSS v4 theme utilities; CSS variables remain the customization authority.
patterns: Keep current compositions and interaction behavior unchanged while validating the new styling implementation pattern.
screenshots: Use Storybook builds and existing stories to review visual parity for the vertical slice.

verticalSlice.name: Core action and form feedback
verticalSlice.workflow: Enter a labelled value, submit an action, and receive persistent feedback through Button, Field/Input, and Alert.
verticalSlice.evidence: Existing component tests, required Storybook stories, contract checks, package archive smoke tests, and live Storybook startup.
